summary: 天然石墨从鳞片精矿到球形石墨、纯化料、包覆后的负极活性材料存在明显的选型、球化和纯化收率损失，因此矿山精矿吨数不能直接等同于可用于电池的天然石墨负极吨数。
why_search_may_miss_it: 资源端通常披露精矿产能，下游项目又披露球形化或AAM产能，中间收率和不合格料去向很少被同一资料串起来。

recalled_details.gap_reason: earlier passes separated natural and artificial graphite but did not preserve the natural-graphite conversion-yield chain
recalled_details.schema_implication: natural graphite supply needs stage, input_basis and yield semantics

suggested_queries: 天然石墨 球形化 收率 纯化 负极
spherical graphite yield purification anode active material
disconfirmation_queries: flake graphite concentrate tonnes equal battery anode tonnes without conversion loss

summary: 负极表面包覆常依赖沥青类碳源，包覆材料价格、软化点和供应质量会影响成品成本与性能，因此焦类原料之外还存在来自煤化工/石化体系的独立成本与质量变量。
why_search_may_miss_it: 行业成本拆分常强调针状焦、石油焦和石墨化电费，少量但关键的包覆碳源容易被并入辅料。

recalled_details.gap_reason: feedstock taxonomy covered coke and graphite but omitted coating-carbon inputs
recalled_details.schema_implication: anode BOM should allow minor inputs that constrain qualification or cost

suggested_queries: 负极 包覆 沥青 成本 软化点
graphite anode coating pitch high softening point supply
disconfirmation_queries: anode coating material has no meaningful cost or qualification effect

summary: 快充成为重要电芯卖点后，负极不再只是按人造/天然石墨区分，而出现围绕倍率、粒径、包覆和低阻抗设计的快充产品等级；高倍率能力与能量密度、首次效率、寿命之间的权衡使名义负极产能并非全部可供快充车型使用。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公司通常披露负极总产能，而快充牌号、客户定点与量产窗口散落在技术发布和客户项目中。

recalled_details.gap_reason: earlier passes covered silicon as an energy-density route but not graphite product segmentation driven by fast charging
recalled_details.schema_implication: anode capacity fungibility requires product_grade and qualified_application

suggested_queries: 快充 负极 石墨 高倍率 产品 2022 2023
fast charge graphite anode qualification high rate
disconfirmation_queries: all synthetic graphite anode capacity is fully interchangeable for fast-charge cells

summary: 石墨化行业曾反复讨论连续式或更高效率炉型替代传统间歇式高温工艺，以降低电耗、人工和单位投资；但设备稳定性、产品一致性与客户认证意味着技术宣称不能直接等同于大规模有效产能。
why_search_may_miss_it: 设备路线常以节能或试验线新闻出现，后续是否形成稳定电池级产品和持续开工较难追踪。

recalled_details.gap_reason: graphitization was treated as a capacity and electricity bottleneck, but process-technology substitution inside graphitization was not explicit

suggested_queries: 连续 石墨化 炉 负极 节能 量产
continuous graphitization furnace battery anode commercial
disconfirmation_queries: continuous graphitization achieved immediate broad commercial qualification

summary: 钠离子电池商业化预期把硬碳推成独立负极路线，其前驱体来源、炭化收率、孔结构控制、首次效率和成本与锂电石墨体系不同，因此钠电需求不能简单映射到既有石墨负极产能。
why_search_may_miss_it: 钠电常被放在电芯技术叙事中，负极端的前驱体、收率和独立产能容易被‘负极材料’总量掩盖。

recalled_details.gap_reason: sodium-ion existed as a cross-chain satellite but the anode-specific hard-carbon supply chain was absent
recalled_details.schema_implication: hard carbon should be a distinct material route, not a graphite subtype

suggested_queries: 钠离子 硬碳 前驱体 收率 成本 量产
sodium ion hard carbon precursor yield cost commercialization
disconfirmation_queries: existing graphite anode capacity directly supplies sodium-ion hard carbon demand

summary: 把电池GWh需求转换为负极吨需求时，单位耗用并非常数：电芯能量密度、N/P设计、硅基掺混比例、首效和安全余量变化都会改变每GWh石墨或总负极活性材料耗用。
why_search_may_miss_it: 需求报告经常用固定单耗系数把GWh换算成吨，历史模型版本和实际配方变化往往不被保存。

recalled_details.gap_reason: earlier passes modeled product routes and silicon adoption but not the changing conversion factor from battery energy to anode tonnes
recalled_details.schema_implication: demand conversion requires time-varying material-intensity assumptions and forecast vintage

suggested_queries: 负极 单耗 kg kWh GWh 石墨 硅碳
graphite anode material intensity kg per kWh silicon N/P ratio
disconfirmation_queries: anode tonnes per GWh remained constant across chemistry and product generations
